input:
Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家。孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了。在那个城市，孟母从早到晚都找工作，可是找不到，害得孟母没有钱。难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房。他们搬了到别一个城市找工作。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家：在古代，better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears；住在靠近墓地的地方/墓地附近，delete了，在+Place
- 孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了：孟子，孩子is vague and unclear
- 难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房：wrong information, 搬家因为孟母觉得it is not good to imitate how to offer sacrifices
- 他们搬了到别一个城市找工作：搬到了，另外一个城市，“别（的）” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，this expression is redundant because 古代 already expresses a time period, while 的时候 also means “the time when.”
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 跟孩子搬家：带着孩子搬家，跟 means “with” as a companion, but a mother moving her child to a new home should use 带着 to show that she takes the child with her.
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别一个城市：另一个城市，另一个 means “another one”; 别一个 is not the standard form for “another city.”
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 在那个城市：在他们住的地方，this is the first mention of a city, so 那个城市 has no clearly introduced referent; use a noun phrase that refers back to the place already mentioned.
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 害得孟母没有钱：害得她没有钱，use a pronoun for a close re-occurrence when no other female character competes as the referent.
6. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 住了在：住在，住 describes a continuing state here, so it takes the zero aspect particle; also 在 must come before the place phrase.
7. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 每天在墓地祭拜了：每天在墓地祭拜，daily actions are habitual routines, so they take no 了.
8. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 搬了到：搬到了，when a completed movement uses 到 as a directional complement, 了 follows 到: 搬到了.

items.reason: 古代和的时候都表示时间，按老师的标准这里重复。
跟孩子搬家可以表示母亲和孩子一起搬家，并不是错误。
别一个不适合表示另一个城市，另一个城市正确。
那个城市是第一次提到，前文没有明确可指代的城市。
孟母刚在前一分句出现，按老师的近距离指代规则应使用她。
住在才是正确结构且此处不用了，但住在后面缺少地点，显示的改后文字不完整。
每天表示习惯性动作，按老师的规则不应使用完成体了。
搬到了正确地把了放在到后面，但显示的改后文字缺少目的地而不完整。
